_note: Indicator catalogue shared by the Flask API (explore.py) and the offline mock (mock_data.js). Labels and allowed breakdowns live here; SQL lives in explore.py.

donations.label: Donations recorded
donations.description: Each record in the sourcing table is one donation. Donor IDs are unique per record, so repeat donors cannot be counted separately.

volume_donated.label: Volume of blood donated
volume_donated.description: Sum of volume_donated_(ml) converted to litres.

voluntary_share.label: Voluntary donations (share)
voluntary_share.description: Share of donations recorded as voluntary rather than family / replacement.

units_received.label: Donated units received for processing
units_received.description: Each record in the processing table is one donated unit. Processing records carry no date, so these figures cover the whole log.

components.label: Blood components produced
components.description: Sum of the prbc, ffp, platelets and cryoprecipitate unit columns. One donation can yield several components.

reactive_share.label: Reactive TTI screening results (share)
reactive_share.description: Share of units with a reactive transfusion-transmissible infection (TTI) screening result. A reactive screen is not a confirmed infection; confirmatory testing is not recorded.

discard_share.label: Units discarded (share)
discard_share.description: Share of units with is_discarded = Yes, for any reason (reactive screen, shelf life, storage or handling).

units_distributed.label: Units distributed
units_distributed.description: Sum of quantity_(units) issued to recipient facilities, dated by date_blood_ordered.

orders.label: Distribution orders
orders.description: Number of distribution records. One order can carry several units.

mean_turnaround.label: Mean order-to-receipt time
mean_turnaround.description: Average of turnaround_time_(days): days between date_blood_ordered and date_blood_received.

facility_returns.label: Units distributed vs share returned unused, by facility
facility_returns.description: Each point is one recipient facility. Use it to see whether facilities that receive more blood also return more of it unused.

requests.label: Transfusion requests
requests.description: Number of patient transfusion requests, dated by date_blood_first_ordered.

units_requested_given.label: Units requested and units given
units_requested_given.description: quantity_requested compared with quantity_given. The gap between them is unmet demand.

mean_hb.label: Mean haemoglobin at request
mean_hb.description: Average hb_level recorded with the transfusion request. Aggregated only; no individual results are shown.

reason_hb_fulfilment.label: Mean haemoglobin vs fulfilment rate, by reason for transfusion
reason_hb_fulfilment.description: Each point is one reason for transfusion. Lower Hb indicates more severe anaemia at the time of the request.
